children.name: Myrothamnus flabellifolius  Welw.
children.description: Myrothamnus flabellifolius is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrothamnaceae native to central and southern Africa.

children.name: Myrothamnus moschatus  Baill.
children.description: A small woody xerophytic 'resurrection' shrub (poikilohydric, able to desiccate almost completely in drought and rapidly rehydrate after rain), one of two species of the genus Myrothamnus (family Myrothamnaceae, order Gunnerales). Endemic to Madagascar, especially the seasonally arid south and southwest, it grows on rocky ground; its aromatic musky foliage yields essential oils used in Malagasy traditional medicine.
